test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

I envy the way she_______ all tasks with such ease and speed.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Carries out'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"carries out"** means to perform or complete tasks.
 
• It is the **most suitable option** to convey the intended meaning in the given sentence.
 
• It** implies** that the** subject (she)** is able to accomplish tasks with ease and speed.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *I envy the way she **carries out **all tasks with such ease and speed. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's examine why the other options are **incorrect**:

 
 
• **Dwindles out:** This option is incorrect because "dwindles out" means to gradually decrease or fade away, which does not match the context of the sentence. 
 
• **Bring about:** This option is incorrect because "bring about" means to cause or make something happen. It does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Account for:** This option is incorrect because "account for" means to explain or provide a reason for something.
